title: Four offline harness acceptance suites: latency, replay, source-degradation, label-decision
objective: Implement the four required harness acceptance dimensions from PROJECT_ARCHITECTURE.md section 6 and docs/METHODS_ALPHA_SCORE_AND_DETECTORS.md Part 3.4 as offline, deterministic tsx test suites plus runner CLIs under src/harness-suites, each exiting non-zero on failure and writing a JSON report. Latency uses a virtual clock with fixture-declared per-source latency (hot-path budget under 2s); replay reproduces pinned old-token timelines field-by-field; source-degradation asserts a usable DEGRADED result with warnings and completeness (never crash, never fake precision, never substitute borrowed data for authoritative concentration); label-decision measures detector FP/FN against a versioned tolerance file. No live network.
forbidden_actions: Do not use network APIs, credentials, live providers or real timers for latency measurement (use a virtual clock).
Do not edit package.json; invoke suites via npx tsx.
Do not make any suite pass without a versioned budget or tolerance file.
Do not put secrets or raw provider payloads into fixtures.
